OneMetaKnowledgeBaseChunk.description_en: Contains information about a knowledge base chunk

ChunkMtime.description_en: The time when the chunk was last modified

Id.description_en: The unique identifier for the chunk

parameters.help_en: The ID of the knowledge base
parameters.name: kb_uuid

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. Omit this parameter to get the first page. If the response returns a `NextToken`, it indicates that more results are available. To get the next page, pass this `NextToken` value in the `NextToken` parameter of your next request. A null value for NextToken indicates that all results have been retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标标识。说明 如果不设置该参数，则表示获取第一页的数据。当该参数有返回值时，说明还有下一页，您可以将返回的NextToken作为参数再次请求获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null为止，表示获取到了所有的数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A filter pattern. The operation returns only the chunks whose titles contain this pattern
parameters.help_zh: 知识块过滤，返回知识块标题中包含该值的知识块
parameters.name: chunk_title_pattern

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Valid values:

id (default): The chunk ID.

hits: The number of hits.

modifyTime: The modification time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值范围：

id（默认值）：知识块ID。
hits：热度。
modifyTime：修改时间
parameters.name: sort_field_name

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

ASC (default): ascending order.

DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值范围：
ASC（默认值）：升序。
DESC：降序
parameters.name: sort_order

items.description_en: The data structure for a single chunk

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on this page

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page of results

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID. If you encounter an error, provide this ID for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一 ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该 ID 排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates if the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。                                 
false：请求失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of chunks that meet the filter criteria. (This feature is not yet supported, and the value is always 0.)
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足条件的知识块总数（目前暂不支持，返回值恒定为 0）
